svg.title: Authorized vs landed · reverse
svg.desc: Authorized set is Ops the Host put in the Result after Cap verify. Landed set is Ops the Peer actually applied. reverse has Inverse, Compensation, or Mark non-reversible. Perfect undo of the external world is not promised.
